acceptanceCriteria: Loading the static export on a touch-emulated viewport (hasTouch, isMobile) produces zero pageerrors and the hint still becomes visible after mount
Loading the static export on a desktop viewport produces zero pageerrors and the hint never renders
goal: Touch-device visitors get the discoverability hint with no hydration error and no console exception
intent: WI-011's TouchAffordanceHint reads window.matchMedia synchronously during render, so its initial value differs between the static-export server HTML and the real client render on a touch device, causing a React hydration mismatch (confirmed via Playwright: React error #418 thrown on a touch-emulated viewport, zero errors on desktop)
outOfScope: No change to the hover scale/opacity work from WI-011
no change to the hint's copy or dismiss timing
